title: Laptop Refresh Cycle Policy
content: Acme Corp replaces employee laptops every three years from the date of original issue. Employees whose devices are due for replacement will be contacted by the IT Department in the month prior. Replacement laptops will be pre-configured and delivered to the employee's primary work location. The old device must be returned to IT within 5 business days of receiving the replacement. Data migration assistance is available by submitting an IT helpdesk ticket. Employees who damage a device through negligence before the three-year mark may be required to contribute up to $300 toward the replacement cost.
